Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly classified iodine as a metal. Iodine is a nonmetal (specifically a halogen). Consequently, the Planner concluded that option A contains only metals, when in reality, option A contains both metals (iron, nickel) and a nonmetal (iodine). The correct answer is C) sodium, chromium, copper, as all three are metals.
